about.body: The AJ26 is Jaguar's first-generation AJ-V8 engine, introduced in 1996 and produced through to 2004. It's a 4.0-litre naturally aspirated V8, available across the X308 XJ and X100 XK — two of Jaguar's most significant modern-era models. The engine was also offered in supercharged form (AJ27S) in the XJR and XKR, though our work on naturally aspirated AJ26 applications is what we see most regularly. Later iterations of the AJ-V8 evolved through the 4.2-litre AJ34 and the 5.0-litre AJ133, though the early AJ26 represents a distinct engineering generation with its own specific characteristics.

byModel.body: The AJ26 was fitted across two main applications: the XJ (X308) from 1997 to 2003 in the XJ8 variant, and the XK (X100) from 1996 to 2004 in the XK8. Both models use essentially the same naturally aspirated 4.0-litre V8, though the X100 generation started production a year earlier than the X308. The supercharged AJ27S variant was also available in both model lines (XJR and XKR), though our rebuild work on the naturally aspirated AJ26 is what we most commonly carry out.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ26 spans two different model lines and two generations (X308 and X100), compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec — which we do by registration. Ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ between the XJ and XK applications, even though the base engine code is the same. For supercharged AJ27S applications, the additional supercharger components also vary by model. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
